editorial.blurb: An authentic Hong Kong–style cafe in Chinatown with crispy roasted duck, stewed meats, and noodles that draw locals and travelers alike.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for dine-in to experience the welcoming service, or join the locals in the takeout line; pair any BBQ item with their exceptional HK milk tea.

topDishes.note: Juicy with crispy skin, rivals roasted duck across the country
